prior.name: The Prior
prior.title: Keeper of the Chapterhouse
prior.blurb: Keeper of the Chapterhouse and its seals. Ask where to hunt next, what a seal or a boss asks of you, and when the Altar of Ascension is ready.

sexton.name: The Sexton
sexton.title: Tender of the Acre
sexton.blurb: Tender of the Sexton’s Acre. Ask about gathering, your Grave Laborers, the Bone Grinder, the Ossuary Vault and the day’s Contracts.

apothecary.name: The Apothecary
apothecary.title: Brewer of the Covenant
apothecary.blurb: Brews for the Covenant in the Alchemist’s Wing, through the Chapterhouse’s east door. Ask what to brew, where reagents fall, and how elixirs and tonics differ.
